example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ তার কামাই, তাই সে বিশ্রাম নিচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a day off today, so he's resting.
It's necessary to take time off due to work pressure.
history: The phrase often appears in contexts of labor and employment in Bengali-speaking regions, reflecting everyday struggles with work and rest.
note: The provided example 'কাজ নাই কামাইও নাই' illustrates a situation of neither work nor rest, emphasizing enforced idleness.
